title: kith-tui: Cargo setup + src stubs
description:
What: Add ratatui/crossterm/futures to workspace.dependencies, register kith-tui in workspace members, create crates/kith-tui/ with Cargo.toml and empty stub source files that compile cleanly.

Algorithm:
1. Edit /home/mark/WORK/KITH/Cargo.toml: add to [workspace].members: "crates/kith-tui"
2. Edit [workspace.dependencies]: add ratatui = "0.30", crossterm = { version = "0.28", features = ["event-stream"] }, futures = "0.3"
3. Create crates/kith-tui/Cargo.toml with: name="kith-tui", version.workspace=true, edition.workspace=true, license.workspace=true, [[bin]] name="kith-tui" path="src/main.rs", [lib] name="kith_tui" path="src/lib.rs", deps: tokio.workspace=true, ratatui.workspace=true, crossterm.workspace=true, futures.workspace=true, unicode-width="0.2"
4. Create crates/kith-tui/src/lib.rs: pub mod app; pub mod ui; pub mod event; (empty module stubs)
5. Create crates/kith-tui/src/app.rs: empty (just a comment)
6. Create crates/kith-tui/src/ui.rs: empty
7. Create crates/kith-tui/src/event.rs: empty  
8. Create crates/kith-tui/src/main.rs: fn main() {} placeholder
9. Run cargo build -p kith-tui and verify it compiles

Defensive programming rules:
- No unwrap() in any stub
- All stubs must compile; empty modules are fine

Tests: cargo build -p kith-tui succeeds; cargo clippy -p kith-tui -- -D warnings passes
